annotations.title: Stamp Duty (SDLT) calculator — England & Northern Ireland

description: Calculate Stamp Duty Land Tax for a residential purchase in England or Northern Ireland. Input the price (GBP) and buyer_type: first_time_buyer, standard (moving home, replacing a main residence) or additional_property (second home / buy-to-let); non_uk_resident adds the non-resident surcharge. Returns the total tax, effective rate and the band-by-band breakdown. NOT for Scotland (LBTT) or Wales (LTT) — say so rather than quoting this figure for a property there. Indicative only, not tax advice.

non_uk_resident.description: true if the buyer is not UK resident
